definitions.tapThroughCount: step 6: runs in which something beneath the menu received the touch

definitions.nothingBeneath: step 7/8: no click reached anything beneath the menu after the pick
definitions.pickAtLift: step 7: the menu dispatched its own click on Folder C at the finger's lift
definitions.pickedTouchendReachedDocument: step 7: whether the picked row's touchend reached the document (it did not: the row left the page with the menu)
definitions.moveToTouchendCancelled: step 7: the tap on Move to had its touchend cancelled, so no native click followed
definitions.touchendMinusPointerupMs: step 8: the pick's touchend arrives as the 600 ms task from its pointerup ends
definitions.main45201690: step 8 control: main Production 45201690, which does not have #11859's fix (expected to fail: touchend not cancelled, a click beneath)
definitions.triggerBoxPixelsChanged: pointer row (a): pixels of the trigger box (+-8 pt, 52920 px) that differ before the open vs after the close (ImageMagick AE, fuzz 6%); 0 = no ring left
definitions.pressBeforeHoldEndMs: held attempts: how long before the hold ended the press went down
